about_the_game:
Wild West : The Last Cowboy

Welcome to the ultimate Wild West showdown! Wild West : The Last Cowboyis a thrilling VR shooter that puts you in the boots of a true gunslinger. With charming, cute casual graphics and fast-paced action, this game delivers an immersive Western experience like never before.

1v1 Online Cowboy Duels

Step into the Wild West and challenge real players in thrilling multiplayer gunfights. Whether it's high-noon or moonlight, your shooting skills and quick thinking will determine who becomes the top cowboy. This is real-time action where every shot counts.

Fast Draw Ranking Battles

Show off your reflexes in classic Western-style quick-draw duels. Compete in global multiplayer rankings and prove you're the fastest cowboy in the Wild West. Draw your revolver, aim precisely, and shoot before your opponent even has the chance to react.

Explore the Action-Packed Wild West

Roam across scorching deserts, rugged frontier towns, and bustling saloons. Every shootout captures the true spirit of the Wild West, delivering a dynamic and immersive action experience.

A VR Shooting Experience Like No Other

Put on your VR headset and enter a world where you are the hero of your own Western legend. Engage in intense multiplayer shootouts, outdraw rivals in duels, and rise through the ranks as the last cowboy standing.

Will You Be the Last Cowboy Standing?

The Wild West is calling. Grab your revolver, take your stance, and prove you have what it takes. Multiplayer. Action. Shooting. Cowboy. This is your moment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index, Meta Quest 2/3/3s/pro
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index, Meta Quest 2/3/3s/pro
